findings.title: Reconciliation was presented as calibration (no independent direction/magnitude oracle)
findings.description: V3 PASS/PARTIAL verdicts rested on internal reconciliation and a same-author review; the stock-level source oracle had 0/105 valid months for JT, 52W and EW and 45/105 for LowVol.
findings.rootCause: (a) no external reference series for the constructions; (b) sourceMonthContributions marked a whole month DATA_GAP when any single holding lacked an end bar or was quarantined, so the oracle almost never produced a month; (c) completion did not require direction/magnitude evidence.
findings.fix: External oracle layer: Kenneth French Data Library EW market (firm-count weighted size deciles), 12-2 momentum EW deciles and 60-day variance EW quintiles, hash-pinned (SUPERTRADER-V4-ORACLE-MANIFEST.json); VU constructions mirroring each published definition (constructions-v4.mjs) with the explicit missing-bar policy so every eligible security has a return; pre-registered tolerances (compare-v4.mjs); certification levels that separate INTERNALLY_RECONCILED from (PARTIALLY_)CERTIFIED (completion-v4.mjs).
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A1: an EW control that fails its external oracle makes the measurement layer NOT_CERTIFIED
v4-measurement.test.mjs: A1: reconciliation alone is not calibration
findings.freezeImpact: new V4 freeze binds oracle manifest, constructions, tolerances and completion rules
findings.dataImpact: public French files are read inside the runner; values stay private

findings.title: LowVol direction conflict with the reference was not flagged
findings.description: V3 read the sign from 45 complete months of SOURCE_GROSS only; FRENCH_VAR direction was positive.
findings.reproduction: V3 LowVol result vs FRENCH_VAR (adversarial review A2)
findings.rootCause: direction was informational, not a hard check, and the valid-month fraction was not part of the verdict
findings.fix: DIRECTION is a hard check whenever the oracle mean exceeds the direction floor; minimum valid-month share 95 %; per-check flags published
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: comparison: identical series PASS; sign-flipped series FAIL on correlation and direction (A2)

findings.title: Split logic not bound by the freeze
findings.description: freeze-v3 followed literal imports only; return-series.js and canonical-total-return.js (loaded via require(path.join(root, ...))) were not hashed.
findings.reproduction: BACKTEST-CALIBRATION-FREEZE-V3-38685897684.json files list lacks quant/engines/return-series.js and canonical-total-return.js
findings.fix: freeze-v4.mjs follows require(path.join(root|ROOT, '...')), fails closed on any unresolvable dynamic require, binds an explicit corporate-action/split policy section (files, functions, adjustment mode, raw/adjusted convention, exception codes, terminal/acquisition/cash-proceeds/delisting handling) and demands every runtime split file in the closure
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A3: the V4 freeze closure binds the split/total-return loaders
v4-measurement.test.mjs: A3: an unresolvable dynamic require is reported
findings.freezeImpact: split/TR loaders now in the V4 code closure and corporateActions.fileHashes

findings.title: Positions without a bar held at the last close indefinitely
findings.description: No staleness limit; 52W diagnostics showed positions without bar on 2,175 of 2,198 days.
findings.rootCause: accounting valued missing bars from lastMarks without any limit or settlement
findings.fix: measurement-policy-v4.mjs: stale carry for at most 5 sessions (one trading week, not result-derived), then SECURITY_UNAVAILABLE settlement at the last close (data-event factor 1, sensitivities -30 % and 0); zero-volume unchanged closes do not reset staleness; hard ending-position freshness check
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A4: a held position without a bar is settled after the stale limit
findings.strategyImpact: affects all holders of gapped securities identically for every method

findings.title: Quarantine terminal booked before the information that revealed it; DQ received the 0.7 delisting factor
findings.description: terminal.date = quarantine.from although observedAt can be later; data quarantine treated as economic delisting.
findings.rootCause: terminal construction ignored observedAt; terminal factor did not distinguish data events
findings.fix: causalQuarantineTerminal: first session on/after max(from, observedAt); data events settle at the last valid close (factor 1) with mandatory -30 %/0 sensitivities; economic delisting scenarios unchanged
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A5: data-quarantine terminal is booked on the first session on/after max(from, observedAt)
v4-measurement.test.mjs: A4/A5: data events settle at the last valid close

findings.title: R8 dividends circular; calendar checks tautological; off-calendar bars dropped silently
findings.description: R8 took book.dividends as given (+500 passed); off-calendar bars with dividend/split fields were dropped.
findings.rootCause: review reused the book's own aggregate
findings.fix: review-v4.mjs R8b recomputes dividends from the replayed fill ledger and source bars; off-calendar census is a hard check that fails if any off-calendar bar carries a dividend or split
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A6: dividends recomputed from the fill ledger match; an inflated booked dividend fails R8b
findings.residual: V3 tournament books are not re-reviewed with R8b (V3 is historical evidence)

findings.title: Signal formation not reviewed (no truncation test, no independent scorer)
findings.description: formationDates came from the run under test.
findings.fix: truncationReview: independent scorer on data truncated at the formation date for a pre-registered sample (first, last, every 9th month); any bucket membership mismatch fails
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A7: the independent truncated scorer detects a membership that used information after formation
findings.residual: JT 6/6 and GH 52W V3 engines are not re-scored; they stay INTERNAL_CONTROL_ONLY / DIRECTIONAL

findings.title: Dust deletion not value-aware
findings.description: 1e-10 share threshold hid 15.6 at a 2e11 price; the V3 ledger cancelled the gap by construction.
findings.fix: accounting-v4.mjs: residual written off only below 0.01 value; summed write-offs capped at 1.0 per book (fail closed); order floors value-aware
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A8: summed dust above the book cap fails closed

findings.title: 74 securities with adjusted price level above 1e6 (INFO only)
findings.description: R10 census; 58 traded in the JT top book.
findings.rootCause: no classification; backward-cumulative split adjustment of serial reverse splitters produces extreme adjusted levels, and wrong provider split factors produce the same symptom
findings.fix: price-sanity-v4.mjs classifies each security (genuine high nominal, genuine serial reverse splits, split artifact, unit issue, currency, stale/unadjusted, ticker identity, source error) from raw-vs-declared-split consistency; only proven defects are quarantined from the first defective event; pre-registered sensitivity excludes all affected names; counts by class are published by the run
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A9: >1e6 levels are classified, not clamped; only proven defects are quarantined
findings.strategyImpact: defective histories quarantined for all methods

findings.title: Completion builder trusted self-reported status; duplicates last-wins; single generic reason
findings.description: referenceOk true for any COMPUTED/PARTIAL report.
findings.fix: assembleReview rejects duplicate books and missing books, requires evaluated hard checks; certifyV4 requires each expected oracle exactly once with a valid verdict and splits reason codes
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A10: duplicate or missing reviewed books are rejected

findings.title: Observed-only universe; drop reasons not public; no calibration sensitivity of the -30 % baseline
findings.rootCause: data limitation (no independent population denominator) plus missing transparency
findings.fix: public universe tables (terminals by kind/year, instrument types, exchanges, canonical rejection reasons); the external EW oracle now measures the effect of the universe difference directly; -30 %, last-price and distress-zero sensitivities run against the oracle
regressionTest: covered by run output schema (universe, sensitivities)
findings.downgradeReason: MAJOR in V3 because the effect of the observed-only universe was unmeasured; V4 measures it directly against the external EW oracle and its sensitivities, so the open part is a quantified data limitation, not an unmeasured defect
findings.residual: the population itself remains observed-only (data limitation, not a code defect); classified MODERATE because the EW oracle quantifies its effect

findings.title: Reconciliation tolerance scaled with final equity; published-close.js not reused (ADR-002)
findings.fix: absolute floor plus a binary64 envelope of gross flows; published-close.js hash-bound and its non-use documented (calibration reads the canonical TR index derived from the same splitFactors)
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A12: reconciliation tolerance is gross-flow based

findings.title: frozenBeforePerformance was a literal flag; createdAt in the freeze id; code changed after public summaries
findings.description: Freeze id changed every run; no external pinning.
findings.fix: content-only freeze id (canonical JSON, createdAt/provenance excluded); the workflow commits and pushes the freeze before any measurement; the measuring job verifies the freeze commit is an ancestor of HEAD and the file equals the committed bytes
regressionTest: v4-measurement.test.mjs: A13: freeze id is content-only
